vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: The finding covers every version of the golang.org/x/crypto module, because the openpgp packages inside it will never be fixed. The binary requires the module for golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt, but none of the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages is compiled into it: Helm signs charts with github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/openpgp instead. CI fails the build if golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp ever enters the dependency graph of cmd/server.
